d: Uncut, unfiltered, and deeply hostile, Season 10 tested the sanity of Zak Bagans and the crew like never before. Relive the most intense lockdowns of the entire season in this high-octane compilation, capturing every second the crew, trapped in dark paranormal investigation rooms, faces unseen physical aggression, sudden temperature drops, and demonic mockery. From disembodied footsteps pacing empty hallways to spirit box voices calling out names, examine the undeniable evidence behind terrifying ghost encounters that left seasoned investigators completely paralyzed with fear.
